title: Fix backend clippy warnings, frontend bug, and overhaul color theme
body:

- Updated `--primary` and `--accent` colors in `frontend/src/index.css` to Professional Blue and Indigo, creating an industry standard look and feel.
- Cleaned up warnings to strictly pass `cargo clippy` and `npm run lint`.
